Why Baldrick

Built by people who actually run shows.

No marketing department invented these. Every board comes from a real need on a real display — and is built to hold up on the night, every night of the season.

Wire it up without the headache

Clear terminals, sensible labels and onboarding QR codes printed right on the board.

Designed to be mounted, not bodged

Compact footprints and free 3D-printable enclosures, so a tidy install doesn't depend on a roll of tape.

Firmware that keeps getting better

Regular updates bring new features and fixes, long after the board is on your wall.
